easy: A big job or piece of work that someone tries to do.

ex.en: Building a treehouse was a big undertaking for our family.
ex.ko: 나무집을 짓는 것은 우리 가족에게 큰 일이었다.

easy: Not yet made all the way the way it should be.

ex.en: My unfinished drawing is still on the desk.
ex.ko: 내 미완성 그림이 아직 책상 위에 있다.

easy: Not finished yet; there is still more to do.

ex.en: I have unfinished homework to do tonight.
ex.ko: 나는 오늘 밤 끝내지 못한 숙제가 있다.

easy: Not well in your body or mind.

ex.en: The unhealthy puppy would not eat.
ex.ko: 그 건강이 좋지 않은 강아지는 먹으려 하지 않았다.

easy: Bad for your body, so it can make you sick.

ex.en: Eating too much candy is unhealthy.
ex.ko: 사탕을 너무 많이 먹는 것은 건강에 해롭다.

easy: Against the law.

ex.en: It is unlawful to steal from a store.

easy: Not liked by many people.

ex.en: The new rule was unpopular with the kids.
ex.ko: 그 새 규칙은 아이들에게 인기가 없었다.

easy: Gone and not there anymore.

ex.en: The vanished cookies were not in the jar.

easy: Turning into gas very easily, like a liquid that dries up fast.

ex.en: Nail polish remover is volatile, so it dries up fast.

easy: Because you want to, not because someone makes you.

ex.en: She voluntarily helped clean the classroom.

easy: Not normal; different from what is usual.

ex.en: He accused his brother of eating the last cookie.
ex.ko: 그는 형이 마지막 쿠키를 먹었다고 비난했다.

easy: More than enough.

easy: The very top of something.

easy: Having stripes or lines on it.

easy: A game where you cover numbers on a card when they are called out.

ex.en: We played bingo at the school party.

easy: A big metal tank that heats water to make steam or warm a building.

easy: Joining things together into one.

ex.ko: 두 반을 통합해서 큰 한 반이 되었다.

easy: Going on without stopping.

ex.en: The continuation of the game was delayed by rain.

easy: A line of cars or trucks that travel together.

ex.en: The convoy of ships crossed the ocean together.

easy: The children, grandchildren, and later family of a person.

ex.ko: 그 왕의 후손들은 아직도 마을에 살고 있다.

easy: Talking and working with other countries to solve problems.

ex.en: Diplomacy helped the two countries stay at peace.
ex.ko: 외교 덕분에 두 나라는 평화를 유지했다.

easy: An order or instruction that tells people what to do.

ex.ko: 교장 선생님은 소방 훈련에 대한 지시를 내렸다.

easy: Being in a worse spot than others.

ex.ko: 키가 작은 것은 농구에서 불리한 점이다.

ex.ko: 시끄러운 개가 내 숙제에서 주의를 흩뜨렸다.

easy: To make someone feel worried or upset.

ex.en: The bad news distracted her all day.
ex.ko: 나쁜 소식이 그녀를 하루 종일 불안하게 했다.

easy: Toward the ground or a lower place.

ex.en: The ball took a downward path into the hole.

easy: A book you read on a screen like a tablet.

ex.en: I read an ebook on my tablet in the car.

easy: Said in a strong way so people notice the word.

ex.en: The teacher said the emphasized word loudly.

easy: A sad, low, gloomy mood.

ex.en: He was in a funk after losing the game.

easy: Being very important and very well known.

ex.en: The greatness of the singer made everyone cheer.

easy: Being very, very big.

ex.ko: 그 산의 거대함에 우리는 깜짝 놀랐다.

easy: Cooked under strong heat.

ex.en: We ate grilled fish for dinner.

easy: Cooked over fire outside.

ex.en: Dad served grilled corn at the picnic.

easy: Feeling that nothing good can happen.

easy: Not good at doing something.

ex.en: I am hopeless at drawing horses.

easy: Happening every hour.

ex.en: The clock gives an hourly chime.

easy: Every hour.

ex.en: The nurse checked on him hourly.

easy: Not in a straight, clear way.

ex.ko: 그녀는 나를 쳐다보며 돌려서 조용히 하라고 말했다.

easy: A kind of light we cannot see that feels like heat.

ex.en: A remote control uses infrared light.

easy: Not steady, so it can change or fall over.

ex.en: The instability of the old bridge worried us.
ex.ko: 낡은 다리의 불안정함이 우리를 걱정스럽게 했다.

easy: A thing that stops you from doing more.

ex.en: Our small yard is a limitation for a big dog.
ex.ko: 좁은 마당은 큰 개를 키우는 데 한계가 된다.

easy: Having to do with words and language.

ex.en: She has strong linguistic skills in two languages.
ex.ko: 그녀는 두 언어에서 뛰어난 언어 능력이 있다.

easy: Having to do with the study of how languages work.

ex.en: My uncle studies linguistic science at college.

easy: A small, solid piece of something with no clear shape.

ex.en: He dropped a lump of clay on the table.
ex.ko: 그는 탁자 위에 찰흙 덩어리를 떨어뜨렸다.

easy: A bump on the body where it puffs up.

ex.en: I got a lump on my head from the ball.
ex.ko: 나는 공에 맞아 머리에 혹이 났다.

easy: On the edge of something.

ex.en: Grass grew in the marginal area near the road.

easy: Seen as being for men or boys.

ex.en: He has a deep, masculine voice.

easy: A stone by the road that shows how far a place is.

ex.en: We passed a milestone saying five miles to town.

easy: An important moment in your life or a long job.

ex.en: Losing my first tooth was a big milestone.
ex.ko: 첫 이가 빠진 것은 큰 이정표였다.

easy: Ten more than eighty.

ex.en: My great-grandmother is ninety years old.

easy: The number 90, which is nine times ten.

ex.en: Nine times ten makes ninety.

easy: A building with big telescopes for looking at stars.

ex.en: We looked at Saturn at the observatory.

easy: A high place or tower from which you can see far.

ex.en: We climbed the observatory to see the whole valley.
ex.ko: 우리는 전망대에 올라 계곡 전체를 보았다.

easy: The open air outside, not inside a building.

ex.en: The kids love the outdoors in spring.

easy: Outside, not in a building.

ex.en: We eat lunch outdoors when it is sunny.
ex.ko: 우리는 날씨가 맑으면 밖에서 점심을 먹는다.

easy: Plain and boring, with nothing new or exciting.

ex.en: The pedestrian story put me to sleep.
ex.ko: 그 평범하고 따분한 이야기를 듣다가 잠이 들었다.

easy: A long case that holds seeds, like peas.

ex.en: I opened the pod and found five peas.
ex.ko: 나는 꼬투리를 열어 완두콩 다섯 알을 찾았다.

easy: A message about what will happen in the future.

ex.en: The old story told of a prophecy about a dragon.

easy: In a way that shows you feel good about yourself or others.

ex.en: He proudly showed his drawing to the class.
ex.ko: 그는 자랑스럽게 반 친구들에게 자기 그림을 보여 주었다.

easy: Building something again.

ex.en: The rebuilding of the old school took a year.
ex.ko: 낡은 학교의 재건에는 일 년이 걸렸다.

easy: A machine that saves sound or pictures.

ex.en: I used a recorder to save my voice.

easy: Behaving in a polite, proper way.

ex.en: He wore a respectable suit to the party.
ex.ko: 그는 파티에 점잖은 정장을 입고 갔다.

easy: Good enough that people think well of it.

ex.en: She has a respectable job as a nurse.
ex.ko: 그녀는 간호사라는 존경할 만한 직업을 가졌다.

easy: Showing that you care about other people's feelings.

ex.en: Be respectful when your teacher is talking.

easy: As a usual, regular habit.

ex.en: She routinely walks the dog after school.
ex.ko: 그녀는 방과 후에 규칙적으로 개를 산책시킨다.

easy: The force that slows things down when they rub together.

ex.en: Friction between my hands made them warm.
ex.ko: 두 손 사이의 마찰로 손이 따뜻해졌다.

easy: A picture made by putting paper on something and rubbing it with a pencil.

ex.en: I made a rubbing of a leaf with my crayon.

ex.en: The neighbor saluted us with a wave.
ex.ko: 이웃 아저씨가 손을 흔들며 우리에게 인사했다.

ex.ko: 폭풍이 너무 심해서 학교가 문을 닫았다.

ex.ko: 방 청소할 때 게으름 피우지 마라.

easy: So smooth or wet that you can slip.

ex.en: The icy steps were slick.

easy: Getting slower.

ex.en: The slowing of the bike came from the hill.

easy: Happening by itself without anyone planning it.

ex.en: Their spontaneous clapping surprised the singer.

easy: Done on the spot without a plan.

ex.en: She gave a spontaneous speech at the party.

easy: Having a little star mark next to it.

ex.en: Do only the starred questions on the test.

easy: A sharp point that grows on a plant.

ex.en: A thorn pricked my finger on the rose bush.
ex.ko: 장미 덤불의 가시가 내 손가락을 찔렀다.

easy: A small paper with glue on the back that sticks to things.

ex.en: I put a star sticker on my notebook.

easy: The kitchen machine with burners where food is cooked.

ex.en: Mom put the pot of soup on the stove.
ex.ko: 엄마가 국 냄비를 레인지 위에 올려놓으셨다.

easy: A machine that makes a room warm.

ex.ko: 우리는 난로 옆에 앉아 몸을 녹였다.

easy: A shape or pattern you copy to make other things.

ex.en: I traced a star using a cardboard template.
ex.ko: 나는 종이 틀을 대고 별을 그렸다.

easy: Sending short written messages with a phone.

ex.en: Texting during class is not allowed.
ex.ko: 수업 중 문자 보내기는 금지되어 있다.

easy: A rule in math that has been shown to be true.

ex.en: We learned a math theorem about triangles.
ex.ko: 우리는 삼각형에 관한 수학 정리를 배웠다.

easy: A wide piece of land.

ex.en: The farmer bought a large tract of land.

easy: Pointing or facing up.

ex.en: The cat gave me an upward glance.

easy: Going up to a higher place.

ex.en: We took the upward path to the top.

easy: Likely to blow up in anger very fast.

easy: Very, very much.

easy: In a crazy way, with no control.

ex.en: The puppy ran wildly around the yard.

easy: Having many curves and turns.

easy: Added up little by little over time.

easy: Close to being the same.

ex.en: She wore a bikini at the beach.

easy: A strap that holds a watch on your wrist.

ex.en: My watch strap broke at recess.

easy: A ring-shaped jewelry worn on the wrist.

ex.en: I made a bracelet with colorful beads.

easy: A small container.

easy: A small medicine pill in a soft shell.

easy: To write down what happens in the order it happened.

ex.en: She chronicled the trip in her diary.

easy: A sweet brown spice that comes from tree bark.

ex.en: Grandma put cinnamon on the apple pie.

ex.en: We saw a cinnamon tree on our trip to Asia.

easy: To understand what something means.

easy: A person or thing that does the same job as another one.

ex.en: The mayor met with his counterpart from Japan.

easy: A set of beliefs a person lives by.

easy: A worker who cuts and shapes stone.

ex.en: The cutter shaped the rock into a block.

easy: Willing to try risky things without fear.

ex.en: The daring girl jumped off the high diving board.
ex.ko: 그 대담한 소녀는 높은 다이빙대에서 뛰어내렸다.

easy: New and different from what people did before.

ex.en: The daring play used a bold new style.
ex.ko: 그 참신한 연극은 대담하고 새로운 방식을 썼다.
